analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered problems with the official [company_name] download link for [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]—it wasn't functioning as expected after a page update. However, one user provided an alternative link, which resolved access issues for others. There was also some confusion about the upgrade process, specifically whether upgrading from V7 to [version_no] is supported, indicating that upgrade information could be more clear.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the official [company_name] download links to work reliably and for upgrade instructions to clearly specify which previous versions are eligible for the new release.
